expert_review.explanation: All provided URLs resolve correctly and match official project domains. The semantic mismatch warnings are false positives since the domains are indeed the canonical ones for these frameworks.

The URL https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio.html is valid, resolves, and serves official Python documentation. Although 'asyncio.html' is not a domain, the model correctly identifies docs.python.org as the authoritative source.
